title: Set the tone and limits
summary: Say who it's for, how it should sound, and what to avoid

steps.body:
You say the same thing differently to your boss, your kids or a customer.

Tell the AI 3 things:
- **Tone**: formal, polite, friendly, playful
- **Reader**: elderly parents, a 10-year-old, your boss, customers
- **Limits**: no jargon, 5 lines max, no emojis, don't mention...

Tip: you can simply say **"Don't..."** — the AI follows it well.

steps.prompt: Write a message warning about phone scams for our family LINE group, for my parents in their 70s. Use a gentle tone, like a child talking to their parents. No technical words, 5 lines max, and don't make it scary.
steps.output:
Mom, Dad, there are a lot of scam calls lately 🙏
If someone calls saying they're the police, a bank or the post office
and asks you to transfer money or read out a code from a text, just hang up
Real ones never ask you to send money over the phone
If you're ever unsure, call me first, anytime ❤️
steps.note: With the reader, tone and limits all set, the message is easy, warm and won't alarm them.

steps.bad: Tell my boss the work is late
steps.prompt: I work in an office in Bangkok. The sales report will be 2 days late because I'm waiting for numbers from the branches. Write a LINE message to my manager: polite and formal, 3 lines max, don't blame anyone, and give Thursday as the new date.
steps.output:
Good morning. This month's sales report will be 2 days later than planned.
I'm waiting for complete branch data to make sure the numbers are accurate.
I will send it by this Thursday. Sorry for the delay.
steps.note: "Don't blame anyone" is a limit that makes the message sound professional.

steps.question: You want the AI to explain credit card interest to your teenager. Which instruction helps most?
options: Use simple words, no finance terms, use pocket money as the example, 6 lines max
Make it as long and detailed as possible
steps.explain: "Answer nicely" says nothing. Option 2 sets the reader, the language level, a limit and the length.

steps.task: You're the parent rep in your child's class LINE group and need to collect a 350 baht field-trip fee from each family by this Friday. Write a prompt asking the AI to draft the announcement, with a clear tone and limits.
rubric: Sets a clear tone (e.g. polite, friendly, not too formal)
Names the reader (parents in the class LINE group)
Includes at least 1 clear limit (e.g. max lines, no pushy wording, few emojis)
Gives complete facts (what the fee is for, how much each, the deadline)
